blind.description: A modular medieval half-timber wall section featuring a projecting shop display bay. It consists of dark brown wooden framing beams with off-white plaster infill panels. In the center is a multi-paned display window with a wooden awning above and supporting corbels beneath the shelf. Inside the window shelf sit three small potion bottles or jugs (two reddish-brown, one green) set against warm amber-tinted window panes. Surfaces are continuous, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A thick horizontal brown bar representing the top beam and wall width, with a rectangular shelf/canopy projection protruding outward from the center front.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.15 to 1.2 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 6.5 to 7 feet tall), and about 4.5 to 5 feet wide.
